def VTask.subtypePreimage : {α : Sort u_1} -> {β : Sort u_4} -> (p : α → Prop) -> [DecidablePred p] -> (x₀ : { a // p a } → β) -> { x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ } ≃ ({ a // ¬p a } → β) := by
  intro α β p _ x₀
  have h₁ : { x : α → β // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ } ≃ ({ a : α // ¬p a } → β) := by
    -- Define the forward direction: from {x : α → β // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀} to ({a : α // ¬p a} → β)
    let f : { x : α → β // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ } → ({ a : α // ¬p a } → β) := fun ⟨x, hx⟩ => fun ⟨a, ha⟩ => x a
    -- Define the backward direction: from ({a : α // ¬p a} → β) to {x : α → β // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀}
    let g : ({ a : α // ¬p a } → β) → { x : α → β // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ } := fun y => ⟨fun a => if h : p a then x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ else y ⟨a, h⟩, by
      -- Prove that the constructed function satisfies the condition x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀
      funext ⟨a, ha⟩
      simp [ha]
      <;>
      aesop
      ⟩
    -- Prove that f and g are inverses of each other
    refine' ⟨f, g, ?_, ?_⟩
    · -- Prove that f ∘ g = id
      intro y
      simp [f, g]
      <;>
      ext ⟨a, ha⟩
      <;>
      by_cases h : p a <;>
      simp_all [h]
      <;>
      aesop
    · -- Prove that g ∘ f = id
      intro ⟨x, hx⟩
      simp [f, g]
      <;>
      ext a
      <;>
      by_cases h : p a <;>
      simp_all [h]
      <;>
      aesop
  exact h₁
